Module org.example.sodoku
Package com.example.sudoku.model

Interface ISudokuModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
SudokuModel
public interface ISudokuModel
Interface that defines the contract for the Sudoku game model. Covers matrix access, validation, puzzle generation, hollowing, and the hint system.
